description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewDashlet' that extends 'ViewListView' and manages the display and interaction logic for dashlet views within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It handles constructing the view, managing breadcrumbs, AJAX content, and Smarty templating for the dashlet configuration interface.

classes.name: ViewDashlet
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing the dashlet view within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including constructing the Smarty template, handling AJAX breadcrumbs, and managing module-specific behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewDashlet object, setting module, layout, package, and context based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module, translating the string 'LBL_MODULE_NAME' in the 'Administration' context.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden method that does nothing, preventing default pre-display behavior.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet view, optionally in preview mode, using Smarty templates.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Constructs an AjaxCompose object with breadcrumb navigation based on whether the view is from ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Builds and configures a Smarty template object with relevant data, language, buttons, and UI elements for the dashlet view.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Generates the title string for the dashlet view, optionally using the package module name.
